question: In a certain code language, 'TRAIND' is written as 'FPKBSU', and 'POKRSB' is written as 'DUTLPQ'. How will 'ANLCGH' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Here,

'TRAIND' is written as 'FPKBSU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e7ff45ddd92e96400612dcce4e38f52eb8d36d000b69823d0c6b843bf711135.png] 

And, 'POKRSB' is written as 'DUTLPQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/383bfcc816682ddaaf478645db993511b3aa0a4e8536c5a0af5d28b91540d842.png] 

Similarly, for ANLCGH: ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e73567065f4a391b12ae83b8814e689ad4bb605e6d29d107dcca7322f62dc620.png] 

So, 'ANLCGH' will be written as 'JIEMOB'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
